description: Value fields for a parcel from its free card (GET /api/v1/parcels/{id}): market_value, avm_value with avm_confidence / avm_method, total / land / improvement assessed value, tax, last sale price and date, price_per_sqft. Numbers are normalized to JSON numbers (null = not held). Use when the user asks for a property's value, market estimate, AVM, or wants to compare assessed vs market. Do NOT use as a substitute for an appraisal — this is a modeled estimate. Historical AVM (as_of) is not supported; the tool returns the current snapshot. Free read — never purchases anything.

as_of.description: ISO date — historical AVM. NOT SUPPORTED; ignored.

parcel_id.description: PropRaven parcel ID. Canonical form is state_fips:county_fips:parcel_id, e.g. "37:119:12104406" (the legacy 5-digit form "37119:12104406" and PropRaven parcel UUIDs are also accepted). Get one from parcel_lookup or parcel_search.

name: valuation_estimate
